items.title: The descent set of the tableau of a matching is its set of short chords
items.author: Avichai Marmor
items.work: Schur-positivity of short chords in matchings
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled proposition at source lines 897-900: for a matching m in M_{N,f} with tableau T = T(m), the descent set of T equals the set of short chords of m. The proof (source lines 901-906) has two inclusions of different character: the first reads the descent directly off the definition of the two-row tableau, while the second takes a descent i, produces an unstable chord (j,i+1) from the second row and then has to exclude j < i by showing that the resulting unstable chord would intersect a chord of the first row, contradicting the stability of intersecting chords. The statement records the identity of the two sets and neither the construction of the unstable chord nor the crossing argument.
